page.title: Kog'Maw ADC: carry into fed assassins

items.text: Kog'Maw ADC · carry from behind into fed assassins

Team behind. Syndra, Qiyana and Yone fed. How does Kog still 1v9?
Ranges and cooldowns: LoL wiki, pulled 2026-11-07.
Stats: coachless.gg 16.21 and u.gg 26.21 (URL 16_21),
NA where the sample allows. Icons: Data Dragon 16.22.1.

Bars start at the caster. Red = starts their lockdown (CC).
Sepia = damage only. Ticks: W rank 1, R ranks 1 / 2 / 3.
Centre to centre; hitboxes add ~65 units on each side.

• Every one of them can start a lockdown from
further away than you can shoot back: Syndra +590,
Qiyana +465, Yone +590 units past your W range,
before Flash.
• So you cannot win by out-ranging them. Kiting
alone loses.
• You win by making their start point cost
something. To lock you down they must first get
within 875 to 1,300 units of you. Put your
frontline and support about 600 ahead and that
spot is inside your team's range.
• Your long tools are for scouting and zoning, not
killing: E (1360, slow) and R (up to 1800, gives
sight and reveals for 2 s) reach further than any
of their engages.
• Syndra is the odd one: she does not need to walk
in. Her Q then E stun hits from 1,300 behind her
own team. Against her, standing behind a minion
wave or a wall matters more than standing behind
your team.
he has to pass your team first
After they use it, how long until it is back?

Base cooldowns, LoL wiki, no ability haste.
Thick bar = max rank, thin line = rank 1.
Your W: 8 s on, 17 s cooldown

• Each of them has one or two buttons that decide
the fight. Once a stun button is spent, they are a
squishy melee or short-range mage for a while, and
you out-damage that.
• Ults are the big window: 80 to 120 s. If Yone or
Qiyana ults your frontline, that is your fight,
not a reason to run.
• Short windows matter too: Syndra's E is down for
15 s, Yone's E for 10 to 22 s. Walk up only right
after you see it used.
• Your W is down 9 of every 17 s. Never show
yourself with W on cooldown; it is your whole
range and half your damage.
• Fed does not change cooldowns. It changes how
fast they kill you, so the rule gets stricter, not
different.

u.gg NA core (Dusk and Dawn, Sorcerer's
Shoes, Shadowflame). Plays from R range.

Stasis after their CC ends, or as Syndra's R starts. Their
follow-up hits nothing and your team gets 2.5 s to turn on
them. Best into Yone and Qiyana.

Blocks one whole ability. Strong when one spell is the
whole threat (Syndra's Q then E, her R). Weak into Yone
and Qiyana, whose Q pops it first.

Not defense. If they stack MR to survive your R, this is
how you kill them first. Kill speed is also safety.

u.gg NA core (Guinsoo's Rageblade,
Gluttonous Greaves, Navori Flickerblade).
Plays from W range.

Still a damage item: attack speed and on-hit, plus 45 MR
and 20% tenacity. The best answer to Syndra and to Yone's
magic half.

A second life when they jump you. Good if your team can
punish the 4 s revive; useless if 4 of them wait for it.

All three lock you with a knock-up first (airborne), which
Quicksilver cannot remove. It only clears the stun after
it. Rarely worth it here.

Takes 30 to 60 off each of their next 3 hits. Yone and
Qiyana combos are many small hits; Syndra's is a few big
ones.
WPA World D+ −2.3 ±3.6 (742). NA: under threshold.

Barrier works on any damage, including during a knock-up.
Cleanse, like Quicksilver, cannot remove the airborne
part.

WPA World D+ Barrier −0.53 ±0.9 (12.5K) · Cleanse +0.96 ±2.9
(1.2K). Picked before the game, not vs these.

Omnivamp keeps you alive through poke and grows with
takedowns. Mercury's 30% tenacity only shortens stuns, not
knock-ups.

• good / partly / no is my read of the CC types on the
LoL wiki, not a measurement. All three lock you with
airborne first: Syndra's E knock-back, Qiyana's R
knock-back, Yone's Q3 and R knock-up. Nothing removes
airborne.
• That is why the answers here are stasis, a spell
shield, a second life, shields and resists, and not
Quicksilver or Cleanse.
• Buy one answer, not three. A behind Kog that builds
only defense survives and then cannot kill anyone. Third
or fourth item is usually the slot.
• Grey lines: coachless WPA, patch 16.21, ± = rough 95%
noise from the game count. Most are inside their noise.
Tab 4 has the details.
Coachless WPA for the defensive answers

Patch 16.21, Diamond+, all Kog'Maw ADC games.
Coachless's "vs champion" filter is paid.
● World D+ (21.7K games)   ◆ NA D+ (~2.0K games)

Dot = WPA in percentage points: win rate minus the
win chance at the moment it was bought.
Whisker = rough 95% noise from the game count.
Green / red only if the whole whisker clears zero.
NA shows only where coachless listed the item for NA.

Builds are defined by finished items, so both lean
toward longer games. Compare the rows, not with 50%.

• Almost nobody in NA high elo buys defense on Kog: Zhonya's
132 buys, the rest under coachless's threshold. The numbers
cannot settle this, so the build tab leans on the CC rules.
• Banshee's Veil is the one bright spot: +6.3 ±5.3 on 342
world Diamond+ buys. A lean worth trying, not proof.
• Jak'Sho is the one clear negative: −2.5 ±1.5 on 4.1K buys.
Pure tank stats on Kog cost more damage than they save.
• Mercurial, Mercury's and Cleanse sit at or below zero,
which fits "it cannot remove knock-ups". Small samples, so a
fit, not a result.
• On-hit wins more than AP in NA below Master+ (56.2% vs
48.4% at All ranks); at Master+ and Challenger they are
inside each other's noise.
• None of this is filtered to "behind, into assassins". That
needs a paid coachless filter or a match-by-match pull.

Behind into fed assassins, every death is worth
more to them than any farm is to you. Farm with W
and E from max range, clear waves under tower, and
give up a plate or a drake rather than walk into
fog.
Light the map before you move

They need fog to start from 1,000 to 1,300 units
away. Ward the flank you walk past, sweep with
Oracle's Lens if you have it, and spend R (1300 /
1550 / 1800 range, 2 s reveal) to scout brush
before you step in.

Frontline and support about 600 units ahead of
you, or a minion wave in front of you against
Syndra. The assassin must enter your team to reach
you. Never be the closest champion to the fog.

Do not start the fight. Wait for the stun button
(Syndra E, Qiyana R, Yone R) to land on someone
else, then turn W on and shoot whoever came in.
Fed assassins are still squishy once they are
inside your team.

Play objectives where they have to walk to you:
Baron and Dragon pits, jungle entrances you have
warded. Open lanes favour flanks. If they take an
objective you cannot contest, take a tower or a
camp on the other side.

This comp wants an enchanter support or a
frontline that stays next to you. Ping your
support to stand with you, not to roam. Your E
slow (up to 60%) is your own peel: aim it at the
gap closer, not for damage.

W rank 5 (W maxed first)
W range 710, 6% max HP

• W hits for a % of max health, so your damage grows
with their HP items while their burst does not.
Assassins peak at 2 to 3 items; you peak at 4 to 5.

• Every level and item you reach without dying moves the
fight toward you. Stalling is a real plan, not giving
up. (This is the logic, not a measured game-length
curve.)

You do not 1v9 by outplaying three
assassins. You 1v9 by being the last one
they can reach, so they spend their
buttons on your team, and you shoot for
the 80 to 120 s after.

AP: Zhonya's or Banshee's 3rd, fight
from R range.
On-hit: Wit's End 3rd, Guardian Angel if
your team can punish the revive.
Both: Bone Plating, Barrier, no
Quicksilver.

source.note: coachless patch 16.21 (Diamond+, NA and all regions), u.gg 26.21 (URL 16_21) NA. Free tier: one patch, no 'vs champion' filter (paywalled), so these are all Kog'Maw ADC games, not only games into assassins. 'Hide low occurrence' was off. NA Diamond+ hides any item under about 130 buys, so most defensive items only show for all regions.
